steps.label: Isolate
steps.sub: cut network access, keep the agent connected for investigation

steps.label: Kill process
steps.sub: stop a confirmed-bad process immediately, host stays online

steps.label: Quarantine file
steps.sub: move or encrypt the file so it can no longer run

code:
BEFORE isolation: full network access -- C2, lateral movement, exfil all possible

AFTER isolation:
  Network traffic:        BLOCKED
  EDR agent <-> console:  OPEN (secure channel)
  Machine power state:    STILL RUNNING
caption: The attacker loses every path off the host except the one the analyst controls.

code:
Isolate:     RAM evidence intact -- processes, injected code, connections all visible
Power off:   RAM evidence GONE -- fileless attacks leave nothing else behind
caption: A fileless attack never wrote most of what matters to disk -- powering off destroys the only copy.
